cohort_total_n_excerpt: Participants, 50-76 yr, were 35,239 male members of the VITamins and Lifestyle (VITAL) cohort who were residents of western Washington state, and who completed an extensive baseline questionnaire in 2000-2002.
reason: The prospective cohort evaluated incident invasive and total prostate cancer. The abstract does not report an aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal incidence endpoint; the term invasive alone does not establish aggressive disease.
